<thought>To locate a suitable retrosynthetic template for a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) where an aryl halide is replaced by a primary amine, I will search the template catalog using a representative aryl‑halide substrate (e.g., 4‑chloro‑nitrobenzene) and specify that the reaction breaks an “aryl halide” group and forms a “primary amines” group. This should return templates that encode the C–X → C–N transformation typical of SNAr.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1[N+](=O)[O-])Cl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
